decision_engine: engine.py (own: digraph6 parser, W from CLAUDE.md s2, L = bd*(t+1)*(-I+W) integer, Faddeev-LeVerrier charpoly, Bareiss Hurwitz minors three-valued, Fraction Gauss-Jordan positivity); alpha.py (own compression of A to 1^perp in the basis e_k - e_(k+1), sympy charpoly, identity n*chi_perp == chi_A - chi_{A+J} asserted, g Hurwitz / gcd(g(mu),g(-mu)) axis analysis); limit_replay.py (own t=infinity replication: a = adj(C)1, s, omega = det(muI+C+J)-det(muI+C), Orlando minor Delta_6, sympy real-root isolation on the squarefree product, cells decided at rational samples)

sampling_rules.never_positivity: all 331,427 verdict=never records without 'cert', sorted by Python string order of d6, indices floor(i*N/300), i=0..299
sampling_rules.never_full: all 7,078 verdict=never records with 'cert', same rule
sampling_rules.B / S: filter8 regenerated on orbitenum 'G^~~~{' 29 0/300 (K8 minus one edge, 19,814,771 digraphs: 540 S, 16,757 B) and orbitenum 'GN~~~{' 29 0/1000 (17,073,592 digraphs: 50 S, 9,557 B); pools in enumeration order (K8-e part first), indices floor(i*N/300)
sampling_rules.non-printed domination-free: filter8 --domfree output of the same two parts (1,309,404 + 987,000 D lines) minus the printed S/B lines: pool 2,269,500 in enumeration order, indices floor(i*N/300)
sampling_rules.non-printed non-domination-free: every 50,000th line of the raw orbitenum streams (739 lines), those not in the --domfree lists (731), first 300
sampling_rules.why not the task's '<20M single-graph jo: no jobs.tsv row with split '-' and a single graph has a count below 20M (minimum 167,269,668); every graph in graph_counts.json below 20M that was tested (GTm||{, GEv]}{, GQ~vvg, GFzvVg) yields 0 survivors and 0 B lines, so B/S samples require dense underlying graphs; orbitenum parts of K8-e and K8-P3 were used instead (each part < 20M digraphs)

grid: beta = 2 + j/40 (j = 1..720 for the never samples, 1..200 for B / non-printed), t in {10000, 100000}, eps = 1/(t+1), delta = (beta-1)*eps; plus for never_full every stored critical interval endpoint and midpoint at both t; points with q <= 1 skipped

results.limit_replay_never_full: 300/300 own all-beta>2 replication: positivity cells exist, no open cell with omega Hurwitz and all a_i > 0 (verdict never, 0 escalations after in-cell re-sampling)
